name: ub
description: Uno Blueprint (ub): an open-source context-engineering toolkit that turns a team's scattered context into service blueprints that people and AI agents work from. Four skills: ub:map drafts, translates and imports a blueprint with sign-off; ub:slice cuts a view for one audience; ub:audit finds gaps, conflicts and stale sources; ub:whatif traces a change before anyone makes it.
